name: Graphene Molecular Dynamics
description: A bilayer-graphene MD sandbox: the top sheet is live molecular dynamics — Morse C–C bonds that break and re-form, sp² angle stiffness and a bending umbrella — resting on a rigid graphene substrate through Lennard-Jones forces. Push mesas, Gaussian bumps or Hencky gas blisters up through the sheet and watch it drape, wrinkle and tear.
